newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cypriots pray for rain while Europe shivers.
newsitem.headline: Cypriots pray for rain while Europe shivers.

text.p: While Europe shivers from its coldest weather in decades, sun-soaked Cyprus is praying for rain to break a drought.
Prayers for rain are to be held in churches across the eastern Mediterranean island on New Year's Day as Cyprus basks in spring-like weather.

"We believe that if we join in prayer to our Virtuous Heavenly Father with a warm soul and deep faith he cannot but hear us and respond to our request," said a circular issued by the Greek Orthodox Church.

Temperatures have averaged two degrees above normal levels of 17 Celsius (62.5 Fahrenheit) since mid-December in the capital Nicosia. The mild winter has left reservoirs at dangerously low levels. Farmers will have to be rationed if the drought does not end soon.
"The situation is very bad," said Lakis Christodoulou, director of the water development department. "The recent rain we had did not help things."
